comment: Owned by the license review. Rust and Zig standard library notices (toolchain_notices.py). A new rustc or Zig version needs its text stored under texts/ with its sha256 here; check-repo fails until then.

rust.binaries: bin/cmux, bin/cmux-tui-ssh/*, bin/cmux-app-host, bin/cmux-browser-host (cmux-tui), bin/cmux-cloud (first-party-apps/cloud/server), bin/cmux-mobile-host (cmux-next-ios/rust), bin/cmux-diff-sidecar (Native/DiffSidecar), and the sample/cloud worker binaries that use the copied pin; the pinned binaries name /rustc/0ef1bc386059596dada8fb65b50425aab2ea637a/

rust.source: rustc/share/doc/rust/COPYRIGHT-library.html in https://static.rust-lang.org/dist/rustc-1.91.0-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.xz (xz_hash a68e3ada151e6eee10374529161d35dc26e8a185bddb14eabe6133f37144e02f in https://static.rust-lang.org/dist/channel-rust-1.91.0.toml; the x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu rustc of 1.95.0 carries the same bytes)
rust.binaries: Iroh.framework: the manaflow-ai/iroh-ffi release xcframework at the Package.resolved revision (release_swift.yml pins toolchain 1.91.0; the v1.2.0-cmux.1.ios17 macOS binary names /rustc/f8297e351a40c1439a467bbbb6879088047f50b3/); the bundle check reads the commit from the binary

zig.binaries: Classic Ghostty (the ghostty submodule) still builds with Zig 0.16.0; no cmux-next binary links it since the ghostty-next upstream sync (manaflow-ai/ghostty-next#74) moved GhosttyNextKit and libghostty-vt to Zig 0.17.0.

zig.source: zig-0.17.0/LICENSE in https://ziglang.org/download/0.17.0/zig-0.17.0.tar.xz (sha256 b6c7f1728f043700d6529bac980800792f824256a9d2f1839b3d62beed0b8abd in https://ziglang.org/download/index.json; byte-identical to the Zig 0.16.0 LICENSE)
zig.binaries: Contents/MacOS/cmux (GhosttyNextKit), bin/cmux and bin/cmux-tui-ssh/* (libghostty-vt): Zig std and compiler_rt
